scope: Secondary analysis after confirmation; no tuning, trial exclusion or rerun. Main and negative controls use predeclared case labels. Six-seed intervals are descriptive, not query-independent inference.
timing_scope: Recorded controller processing, command construction and actuator checking on a shared three-worker Windows run. Excludes subsequent trace writing and physics advancement. Offline simulated timestamps did not advance by wall time; no end-to-end deadline or real-time safety claim.
